description: This file contains the implementation of DefaultGrainActivator, a class that implements the IGrainActivator interface in the Orleans runtime. It is responsible for creating and disposing of grain instances using dependency injection and factory methods.

classes.name: DefaultGrainActivator
classes.description: Implements IGrainActivator for creating and disposing grain instances.

methods.name: DefaultGrainActivator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain activator with dependency injection and grain type information.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain instance using the factory and arguments derived from the context.

methods.name: DisposeInstance
methods.description: Disposes of the grain instance, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous disposal patterns.
